_about: FFIEC v1 test-vector case 017 seal record over the 7 entries in entries.json. The merkle_root is the case-016 7-leaf root produced by the same RFC 6962 §2.1 right-promote rule. Hash and signature fields are PLACEHOLDER values; a conforming verifier-toolchain run computes them from the leaves and an HSM-held Ed25519 signing key.
_sign_payload_note: Ten lines (9 LF separators, no trailing newline). The 10th byte is the single ASCII '0' for dev_mode=false. This is the v1.0a 10-line form per spec §4.3 and design 07 §4.3.
